references: Couple-supplied first-meeting café selfie and two roka photographs; existing personalized cartoon doodle used as the style reference

briefs.brief: Draw the couple seated together at a café in the established cartoon style. Man in a blue polo and cream turban; woman in her ivory dress with small blue floral motifs. Keep black hair and beard, expressive simplified faces, and a mostly white background. Later clothing and food corrections are recorded in the corresponding revision brief files.

Draw the couple standing together in their actual roka outfits, in the established cartoon doodle style. Man in a vivid blue turban, ivory embroidered high-collar jacket and ivory trousers. Woman in an ivory embroidered lehenga with a turquoise dupatta, jewellery and bangles. Add a sparse gold floral arch on a white background. Preserve the couple’s identities and keep the entire figures visible.
